title: Plural of long-vowel words
focus: For these long-vowel words, shorten the double vowel and add -ita/-itä: maa (“country”) → maita.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural partitive of maa (“country”).
exercises.explanation: Shorten aa to a and add -ita: maa → maita. This is the plural partitive of maa (“country”).
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural of long-vowel words: form or use confused
